new_final_main.primary_success: Joint active and per-stream empirical harm<=5% and downside<=5.6036475532487204e-5. Among ALL 11 predeclared comparators (RECENT_MEAN__g12, MWU_MEAN__g04, DUAL_MEAN__g12, RAVM_ORIGINAL, RAVM_D2B_V02, ALWAYS_FT, ER, EWC, HUBER_FT, VALIDATION_COMMIT, FROZEN), identify the comparator with smallest clean/mixed center-equal lifecycle MSE among ACTIVE (at least one clean/mixed commit) and per-stream risk-QUALIFIED methods. Against this global strongest eligible comparator require joint relative MSE improvement >=0.2%, center-cluster paired bootstrap (4000 draws; seed 20261020) 95% delta CI upper<0, >=17/32 center wins, and maintenance cost ratio<=2.5. If no eligible active comparator or necessary scientific data missing, INCONCLUSIVE. Risk-unqualified comparators remain in full reporting but are NOT required to have higher raw MSE than Joint. Report all 11 pairwise MSE/risk/cost results and distinction between empirical risk qualification and universal guarantees.
